title: Subscription to a commodity price database
need: Researchers need daily commodity price series for the food security outlook; the free sources used so far stopped updating in August.
objective: Reliable daily price series for 60 commodities for the 2027 outlook cycle.
scope: Twelve-month subscription with API access for up to 25 researchers, historical series from 2000, and vendor support.

deliverables.item: Subscription active with API keys issued
